title: Render the five units with the placement and density rules
description: Render the bar, banner, sidebar card, contextual note and feed row from web/hooks.py, at the positions and caps in the spec's density table, with the no-go zones. They must work in light and dark themes and on phones at 375px, and be distinguishable in greyscale.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Live 2026-10-25 (Shipped #94, Amplify job 84; Ryan approved the copy and links). Bar, banner, card, note and feed row follow the density table. Checked on the live site: Front shows bar, card and two rows; a decision signal shows bar, a Cyclotron note and a banner; Map shows bar and card; Proposals and Policies show the bar only. No horizontal scroll at 375px.
